Investigation on numerical analysis and mechanics experiments for topology optimization of functionally graded lattice structure

High AM Biomedical Materials openalex Direct Read now mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Long Liu, Bing Yi, Tianci Wang, Zhizhong Li, Junhui Zhang et al. Additive manufacturing 2021-09-01 10.1016/j.addma.2021.102275
单位: School of Traffic and Transportation Engineering, Central South University, Changsha 410075, China
通讯: Bing Yi @ School of Traffic and Transportation Engineering, Central South University, Changsha 410075, China
相关性: 该论文直接研究了功能梯度点阵结构的拓扑优化、数值分析与力学实验，与用户关注的增材制造生物医用植入体方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not include fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or osseointegration evaluation.
动机· 通过拓扑优化设计功能梯度点阵结构以匹配骨刚度，减少应力遮挡。
方法· 采用数值分析与准静态压缩实验验证优化结构的力学性能。
结果· 优化后的梯度点阵结构在刚度匹配和能量吸收方面优于均匀点阵。
验证· 通过LPBF制造样品并进行准静态压缩力学测试。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To design functionally graded lattice structures via topology optimization for stiffness matching with bone to mitigate stress shielding.
Method· Numerical analysis combined with quasi-static compression experiments on LPBF-fabricated samples.
Result· The optimized graded lattice structures exhibited superior stiffness matching and energy absorption compared to uniform lattices.
Validation· Experimental validation through mechanical compression testing of additively manufactured specimens.

单位: Department of Industrial Engineering, Università di Bologna, Bologna, Italy.
通讯: Silvia Brogini @ IRCCS Istituto Ortopedico Rizzoli, Complex Structure of Surgical Sciences and Technologies, Bologna, Italy. Electronic a
相关性: 该论文直接研究了LPBF制造的多孔金属结构与骨之间的力学相互作用及应力遮挡问题。
边界: Does not include fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or osseointegration assessment.
动机· 探究多孔金属支架与骨之间的力学相互作用，以减轻应力遮挡。
方法· 通过LPBF制备不同孔隙率的CoCrMo点阵结构，与牛骨进行压缩实验并用DIC分析应变。
结果· 大孔隙率点阵结构降低了刚度，实现了更平滑的载荷传递。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the mechanical interaction between porous metal scaffolds and bone to mitigate stress shielding in orthopaedic implants.
Method· CoCrMo lattice structures with different pore sizes were fabricated via LPBF and mechanically tested in compression with bovine bone using Digital Image Correlation for strain analysis.
Result· Higher porosity lattices exhibited lower stiffness and smoother load transfer to the bone.
Validation· Ex vivo compression tests on bovine bone with DIC confirmed the strain distribution and load-sharing behavior.

Motivation· To investigate the microstructural evolution, corrosion behavior, and cytotoxicity of Ti-6Al-4V/ZrO2 composite fabricated by directed energy deposition for potential implant applications.

Physics-integrated hybrid framework for model form error identification in nonlinear dynamical systems

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling arxiv Transferable Save for project simulation_case UQ
Shailesh Garg, Souvik Chakraborty, Budhaditya Hazra arXiv preprint 2021-09-01 10.1016/j.ymssp.2022.109039
相关性: 该论文提出的混合框架可用于识别和补偿非线性动力学系统中的模型误差，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的不确定性量化。
边界: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or design optimization; it focuses on model-form error identification in general nonlinear dynamical systems.
动机· 真实非线性系统的模型形式误差未知，需识别并补偿以提高预测能力。
方法· 提出灰盒建模框架，用双贝叶斯滤波估计残差力，再用高斯过程学习映射并修正方程。
结果· 在四个不同动力学系统上验证，框架能可靠估计系统状态并推广到未见环境。
验证· 通过四个数值仿真案例验证框架的适用性和准确性。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To improve predictive capability of approximate governing equations for nonlinear dynamical systems by identifying and compensating unknown model-form errors.
Method· A gray-box modeling framework that estimates residual forces via dual Bayesian filter joint input-state estimation and learns a mapping from estimated states to model-form error using Gaussian process regression.
Result· The framework accurately estimates system states and generalizes to unseen environments across four different nonlinear dynamical systems.
Validation· Validation via simulation case studies on four distinct nonlinear dynamical systems demonstrating reliability and applicability.

通讯: Tobias Schmidt @ Technische Universität München Institute for Turbomachinery and Flight Propulsion85748GarchingGermany
相关性: 该论文展示了代理模型在压缩机壳体设计中的应用，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的有限元代理建模。
边界: This paper focuses on turbomachinery casing design, not on implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or patient-specific FEA.
动机· 减少叶尖间隙对压气机效率的影响，快速评估间隙变化。
方法· 基于有限元模型构建代理模型，替代高保真仿真进行快速间隙评估。
结果· 代理模型计算时间减少99.9%，精度可达制造公差范围。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To reduce the impact of tip clearance on compressor efficiency by enabling rapid assessment of clearance variations.
Method· Surrogate models were constructed from a 2D axisymmetric finite element model of a compressor casing to replace high-fidelity simulations for fast tip clearance evaluations.
Result· The surrogate models achieved a 99.9% reduction in computational time while maintaining accuracy within manufacturing tolerances.
Validation· Validation was performed using statistical methods comparing surrogate predictions with finite element results.

A modified physics-informed neural network with positional encoding

Xinquan Huang, Tariq Alkhalifah, Chao Song 2021-09-01 10.1190/segam2021-3584127.1
单位: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
通讯: Xinquan Huang @ King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
相关性: 该论文提出的位置编码改进PINN方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
边界: This paper focuses on seismic wavefield modeling, not on implant/biomechanics design, and does not address constraint handling or uncertainty quantification.
动机· 标准PINN求解Helmholtz方程时收敛慢且预测过于平滑。
方法· 采用正弦激活函数和位置编码将输入映射到高维嵌入向量。
结果· 改进PINN在收敛速度和精度上显著优于标准PINN。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Standard PINNs suffer from slow convergence and overly smooth predictions when solving the Helmholtz equation for scattered wavefields.
Method· A modified PINN is proposed that uses sinusoidal activation functions and positional encoding to transform scalar input coordinates into high-dimensional embedded vectors.
Result· The proposed PINN with positional encoding achieves notably faster convergence and higher accuracy compared to the standard PINN.
Validation· Numerical benchmarks on the Helmholtz equation demonstrate the superiority of the modified PINN over the standard approach.

Motivation· To report long-term survivorship and radiographic outcomes of a modular cementless femoral stem in complex primary THA.

Validation· Clinical and radiographic evaluation with minimum 15-year follow-up and Engh classification for osseointegration.

Result· The nanonetwork enhanced hydrophilicity, protein adsorption, cell adhesion, migration, mineralization, and in vivo bone-to-implant contact.
Validation· In vitro with hBMSCs and in vivo rabbit femoral implantation for 4 and 12 weeks.

Method· Exosomes were reversibly immobilized on tannic acid-modified sulfonated PEEK via strong interactions, enabling sustained release.

动机· 探索Mg2+和Sr2+与不同比例矿化胶原的最佳组合对骨整合的机制。
方法· 在MC3T3-E1细胞中检测成骨基因和蛋白表达，并在大鼠骨质疏松模型中植入浸渍溶液处理的种植体。
结果· 12mmol/L Mg2+、3mmol/L Sr2+和3:7 nHAC组合显著上调成骨相关基因和蛋白，激活PI3K/AKT通路促进骨整合。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To determine the optimal combination of magnesium and strontium ions with mineralized collagen for enhancing osseointegration and elucidate the underlying signaling mechanism.
Method· MC3T3-E1 cells were cultured with varying concentrations of Mg2+, Sr2+, and two nHAC ratios; osteogenic markers and PI3K/AKT pathway activation were measured; implants coated with the optimal solution were placed in osteoporotic rats.
Result· The combination of 12 mM Mg2+, 3 mM Sr2+, and 3:7 nHAC significantly upregulated Runx-2, BMP-2, and OCN expression and activated the PI3K/AKT/GSK3β/β-catenin pathway, leading to improved osseointegration.
Validation· Validation was performed through in vitro cell differentiation assays and in vivo rat implantation with histological and CLSM analysis.

Motivation· To evaluate whether adding a monolayer of multi-phosphonate molecules to implant surfaces enhances de novo bone formation and osseointegration.
Method· An animal preclinical trial with intra-animal control was conducted in eight Beagle dogs, comparing implants with a moderately rough surface (control) vs. the same surface with an additional monophosphonate layer (test) at 2 and 8 weeks healing, using histologic and micro-CT analyses.
Result· Test implants showed slightly more coronal bone-to-implant contact and higher osseointegration percentage, but differences were not statistically significant.
Validation· In vivo validation via preclinical animal model (dog) with two healing periods.

Motivation· To assess the consistency of comorbidity reporting in recent total hip and knee arthroplasty literature.

Motivation· To investigate whether osteoblasts from different periarticular sites within the same bone type exhibit functional differences that may affect implant fixation.
Method· Osteoblasts were isolated from acetabulum and femoral neck during THA and from femoral and tibial cuts during TKA, cultured, and assayed for proliferation, collagen, ALP, and mineralization.
Result· Acetabular osteoblasts showed lower proliferation, collagen, ALP, and mineralization than femoral neck osteoblasts; tibial osteoblasts had lower collagen and ALP than distal femoral osteoblasts.
Validation· In vitro experiments with cells from multiple patients, statistical comparisons between sites.

边界: This paper is a scoping review on spinopelvic parameters and femoroacetabular impingement, with no quantification of proximal femur stress/strain, micromotion, contact mechanics, or any comparison of intact vs. implanted femur.
动机· 探究脊柱-骨盆参数与症状性股骨髋臼撞击的关系
方法· 系统检索EMBASE、PubMed和Cochrane数据库，按PRISMA指南筛选文献
结果· 骨盆前倾与FAI放射学过度覆盖相关，动态运动中FAI患者后倾减少
验证· 文献综述，无实验验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the relationship between spinopelvic parameters and symptomatic femoroacetabular impingement.
Method· A systematic search of EMBASE, PubMed, and Cochrane databases was conducted following PRISMA guidelines.
Result· Anterior pelvic tilt was associated with radiographic over-coverage in FAI, and symptomatic FAI patients showed decreased posterior pelvic tilt and reduced sagittal pelvic ROM during hip flexion.
Validation· Scoping review without experimental validation.

1220 Dual Mobility Cups in Primary and Revision Thas – A Single UK Centre Outcome Study

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore clinical
Alvin C Yiu, R Thambipillai, M B Toteja, Ashwin Unnithan British journal of surgery 2021-09-01 10.1093/bjs/znab259.1032
单位: St Peter Hospital, Chertsey, United Kingdom
通讯: Alvin C Yiu @ St Peter Hospital, Chertsey, United Kingdom
相关性: 该论文为临床回顾性研究，未涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物应力分析。
边界: No biomechanics modeling, no FEA, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, no implant design or mechanical testing.
动机· 评估双活动度髋臼杯在初次和翻修全髋置换中的临床效果
方法· 回顾性分析2018-2020年54例双活动度髋关节置换病例
结果· 无脱位发生，患者满意度高，活动范围良好
验证· 临床随访数据，最小随访6个月
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate clinical outcomes of dual mobility cups in primary and revision total hip arthroplasty at a single UK centre.
Method· A retrospective study of 54 dual mobility hip replacements from January 2018 to May 2020 with minimum 6-month follow-up.
Result· No dislocations were observed, and all patients reported good range of motion and satisfaction.
Validation· Clinical follow-up data from electronic database.
